author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@chadsansing Went in read the road map. Saw you are doing case studies.

First step then is deciding criteria for case section. For ex You have the pre-post data. You could select X cases in each quartile, select X cases who showed Y growth and compare to group who showed Z growth. You could pick them a priori.

When doing comparative case study analysis for the first time I often recommend using matrix analysis. Don't make it massive. Turn each category of the framework into its own matrix.

Another technique I like to use is thematic network analysis. Great how to guide: https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/83d1/f46f34613d1dc9c93777a8b6796e1f912bd2.pdf

Knowing you though you may even try narrative analysis and tell the case story as a board game and show where people started and stopped using the framework as game cards. That's cool too.
